About the job


The Senior Analyst, International Logistics, serves as a key strategic partner within the Raw Materials Procurement organization, responsible for ensuring the efficient, cost‑effective, and resilient movement of raw materials across the global supply chain. This role combines advanced data analytics with deep logistics expertise to design, optimize, and manage international transportation flows that support production, reduce total landed cost, and strengthen supplier and carrier performance. Serving as a boots‑on‑the‑ground contact, the Senior Analyst drives communication, negotiation, and alignment with both suppliers and transportation providers to ensure operational execution, strategic development and continuous improvement. The Senior Analyst maintains accurate inventory positions through accurate reporting of materials in the supply chain, identifies network inefficiencies, and develops improvement initiatives that enhance service, reduce risk, and support long‑term supply chain competitiveness. Through proactive analysis, cross‑functional collaboration, and continuous process optimization, this position ensures that the company’s global logistics operations are predictable, transparent, and aligned with broader supply chain and business


Scope. Santa Catarina Brazil


objectives


  • Support the efficient and cost‑effective movement of international raw materials by providing accurate data analysis, shipment visibility, and operational coordination.
  • Act as a connector between procurement, logistics, and supplier/carrier partners by translating operational realities and commercial priorities into clear insights and actions.
  • Identify issues and trends, and recommend opportunities for improvement across the international logistics network to strengthen service performance and reduce total landed cost.



What do you need?


To live in Santa Catarina mandatory English 90%

Educational Background: Bachelor of Science in Supply Chain, Business, or a related field, or

equivalent experience.

- Professional Experience: A minimum of 5 years in transportation, international logistics, or

supply chain analytics, with a proven track record of success.

- Detailed knowledge of the North American transportation industry, including LTL, truckload, rail,

warehousing, cross-border, and airfreight

- Knowledge of standard transportation import and export procedures and USDOT requirements

- Advanced experience with transportation pricing methods and practices, customs entry

processes and brokerage/clearance requirements preferred

- Demonstrated experience negotiating commercial terms for both master transportation

agreements and ad hoc projects with carriers, brokers, customs brokers, and rail lines.

- Fundamental understanding of CHEP global operations and business segments preferred

- Thorough understanding of the CHEP network pallet flows and seasonality preferred

Skills and Knowledge - Business Acumen and Problem Solving: Apply knowledge of business rules and processes to

manage organizational tasks efficiently. Utilize strong time management and problem-solving

skills to address challenges effectively



Key Responsibilities May Include:


  • Build and maintain strong relationships with domestic and international carriers, freight forwarders, and suppliers to support reliable and cost‑effective logistics operations.
  • Recommend optimal Incoterms and transportation strategies by assessing risk, cost, and supplier capabilities.
  • Monitor international shipments to maintain accurate daily visibility, escalating delays and risks and supporting timely resolution with carriers, suppliers, and internal teams.
  • Analyze logistics and inventory flow data to identify variances, inefficiencies, and potential cost‑saving or performance‑enhancing opportunities.
  • Prepare regular reporting and dashboards covering shipment status, carrier performance, costs, and inventory impacts to support decision‑making across procurement and operations.
  • Support contract and carrier management activities by gathering performance data, documenting service issues, and contributing to review discussions.
  • Maintain routing guidelines, documentation, and SOPs, helping ensure consistency and accuracy in transportation execution and compliance.
  • Assist with root‑cause investigations into service failures or cost issues, coordinating inputs across carriers, suppliers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with planning, sourcing, operations, and transportation teams to ensure alignment on inbound flows, priorities, and risk areas.

title: Voip Engineer
description:
This role is responsible for technical support and operational management of VoIP voice routes , including route monitoring, troubleshooting, carrier coordination, and route optimization. The position requires a basic background in networking or telecommunications and the ability to handle voice network issues in a fast-paced and sometimes high-pressure environment.


Key Responsibilities


  • Monitor and maintain VoIP routes on a daily basis to ensure stable voice service operations.
  • Track and analyze voice quality metrics (such as ASR, ACD, NER) and investigate abnormalities.
  • Assist in troubleshooting call completion issues , including low connection rates, one-way audio, call drops, and call failures.
  • Communicate with upstream carriers and local operators to resolve routing and connectivity issues.
  • Adjust and optimize VoIP routing strategies to improve call completion rates and call quality.
  • Support new route testing, number testing, and connectivity testing when onboarding new routes.
  • Document technical issues and solutions and maintain internal technical documentation.
  • Provide technical support related to voice communication for internal teams.


Requirements


  • Associate degree or above in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of networking concepts (TCP/IP, IP networking).
  • Familiarity with VoIP technologies, SIP protocol, voice gateways, or SIP trunking is preferred.
  • Basic experience with Linux server operations is a plus.
  • Ability to analyze and troubleshoot technical issues .
  • Fluent in English and Spanish for daily work communication.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience in the VoIP or international voice industry .
  • Familiarity with SIP signaling analysis tools (e.G., Wireshark) .
  • Experience with Softswitch, SBC, Asterisk, or FreeSWITCH .
  • Experience in international voice route operations or call quality optimization .

title: Api Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer API standards and architectural guidelines.


Responsibilities

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Sodexo's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool
  • Experience on Azure, Phyton and API development lifecycle.


What can you expect from us?


- Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

- Opportunities to work outside Brazil

- A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?

All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

Join us and be part of a team that is not just keeping up with the digital future—we’re leading it.


About the role

The Finance Project Analyst will oversee financial performance for assigned projects, focusing on key metrics like budget consumption, invoicing, and cash flow. The role also involves managing vendor contracts, ensuring operational compliance, and escalating financial concerns. Additionally, the analyst will optimize processes, track project health, and assist with forecast, invoicing and payments.

  • Act as a key contact for interpreting and investigating financial results for assigned projects

  • Coordinate with Project Managers on change orders, project status, resourcing, and budgets
  • Assist in developing regular financial status reports for projects
  • Record monthly revenue for contracts and communicate estimates to clients
  • Monitor subcontractor and vendor contracts, acting as the contact point for external/internal resources

  • Track overall project health, including revenues, gross profit, receivables, and project closeouts
  • Ensure that operational procedures are being followed by Project Teams
  • Identify and work with team leads to resolve and/or escalate violations as needed
  • Validate reports obtained from projects and ensure that the reports are provided on time
  • Work with project team leads and program directors on operational support needs, set up and lead project meetings
  • Assist with Resource plan baselines
  • Review and manage exceptions and escalate to stakeholders as needed
  • Process and distribute reports, defining tool requirements
  • Analyze and monitor dashboard reports on every project created monthly
  • Identify planned projects monthly
  • Identify projects with Level of Effort (LOE) overage and escalate these to senior management
  • Schedule invoices and assist in their payment
  • Work with management to optimize processes


Required Experience

  • 3 or more years experience working in financial analysis
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently
  • Able to work well with others
  • Able to use discretion while dealing with confidential matters
  • Able to pay close attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

  • Prior experience in project analysis and ASC 606 revenue recognition strongly preferred
  • Prior experience in portfolio financial management and forecasting strongly preferred
  • Significant past experience in an administrative position with responsibility for audit and processing tasks
  • Ability to follow business rules and procedures while analyzing and identifying errors in processes and data
  • Really good attention to detail
  • Fluent English speaker
  • Availability to work from office in hybrid mode


Education

  • BSC in Accounting/Finance, or related field

Quem você é:

Você combina pensamento estratégico e execução prática, sendo capaz de traduzir metas em planos claros e realizáveis. Constrói relacionamentos baseados em confiança, escutando ativamente e ajustando sua abordagem conforme o contexto e as necessidades dos clientes.   • Capacidade de análise de pipeline e indicadores comerciais utilizando ferramentas de CRM.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens dentro do território.
  • Capacidade de comunicação em Inglês para interação com materiais, sistemas e equipes globais.

Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam:

  • Experiência prévia com soluções Emerson ou portfólio de instrumentação e automação.
  • Vivência consolidada na gestão de canais (distribuidores, representantes, integradores).
  • Experiência em venda de serviços, soluções digitais e IIoT.
  • Familiaridade com os principais segmentos industriais da região.
  • Espanhol.
  • Histórico consistente de superação de metas comerciais com foco em margem e valor agregado.

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass);

title: Area Sales Manager (Santa Catarina State)
description:
Ecorobotix SA. creates innovative robotic solutions that reduce the negative ecological impact of modern agriculture. We have developed an AI-based ultra-high precision spot spraying technology that drastically reduces the amount of chemicals used in crop fields while keeping costs competitive. The technology is currently deployed on our tractor towed ARA machine. By joining our talented and dynamic team, you will contribute to a more sustainable, environment-friendly agriculture in an innovative scale-up at the cutting edge of technology. We are a revolutionary organization with a great work environment that supports creativity through self-motivation.


To pursue our growth in Brazil, we are hiring an experienced entrepreneurial mind based in Santa Catarina State for an:


Area Sales Manager


General objective of the role

As an Area Sales Manager of the Ecorobotix SA. Team, you will be responsible for managing and expanding the sales of agricultural machinery within a designated region. The role involves overseeing existing dealer relationships, optimizing dealer performance, and driving new business opportunities by identifying future dealers and customers as well as driving revenue growth. The Area Sales Manager will work closely with dealers to ensure product availability, support, and training, ensuring the company’s agricultural machinery is effectively marketed and sold. This position requires a leader with a deep understanding of market dynamics, strong leadership skills, and the ability to foster a results-oriented sales culture within the region.


Reporting lines and interactions

This role reports directly to the Commercial Director. Internally, you will closely collaborate with other members of the Sales team and other teams of Ecorobotix. Externally, you will interact with dealers, farmers, partners, associations, trade shows, Agronomists, and CCA’s.


A day in the life of an Area Sales Manager

The Area Sales Manager will travel across the designated territory to visit key accounts, meet new prospects, and support dealer partners. Whether you're pulling into a grower's yard or a dealership lot, you're the face of a cutting-edge ag-tech company that's reshaping the future of precision spraying.


You will showcase how our high-precision sprayer delivers real ROI: less chemical waste, more targeted application, and better yields. You walk growers through the technology— highlighting features like variable rate spraying and intelligent targeting—while grounding every conversation in real-world impact. You sit down and dig into the potential customer’s specific challenges and help them see how the product fits into their operation. You're not just selling equipment;
you're helping solve problems.


“You’re part field representative, part storyteller, part strategist. You’re a trusted advisor selling value, not just hardware.”


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect new customers across Brazil, managing all communication and driving the sales process through to contract signature.
  • Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, ensuring strong order generation and relationship development.
  • Assess customer solvency, share pricing information, negotiate terms, and suggest improvements to optimize pricing strategies.
  • Provide training and ongoing support to partners, while identifying opportunities for expanding and strengthening the partner network.
  • Actively participate in industry fairs, customer demos, and events to increase visibility and drive engagement in the region.
  • Foster collaboration and support within the distributor network to drive sales and enhance product reach.
  • Create compelling content in collaboration with the marketing team to support campaigns and enhance brand presence.


Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Sales and/or Agronomy, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in sales and hands-on experience in agriculture, ag-tech, or precision equipment.
  • Willingness to travel domestically in Brazil.

Must-Have

  • Experience in Ag-tech or chemical distribution.
  • Knowledge in Agronomy related to weeding in field crops.


Your Assets

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, willingness to build relationships with customers.
  • Exceptional written and verbal presentation skills, with clear & consistent communication.
  • High degree of independence, reliability, and spirit of initiative.
  • Driven individual with systematic, goal-oriented working methods.
  • Computer skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM tools.
  • Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills
  • Team-player

title: Pessoa Executiva De Vendas - Shopping Center
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.



Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar na prospecção e desenvolvimento de novos negócios para o shopping, com foco em marcas estratégicas e segmentos de alta competitividade, alinhados ao posicionamento do empreendimento.
  • Conduzir negociações de locação de espaços comerciais (lojas), com abordagem consultiva e foco em operações de médio e alto ticket, garantindo relações sustentáveis e de ganho mútuo.

  • Exercer papel estratégico na curadoria do mix de lojas, com foco na qualificação do portfólio e atração de marcas alinhadas a um posicionamento premium, elevando a competitividade do shopping frente ao mercado.
  • Realizar mapeamento constante de concorrentes diretos, acompanhando movimentos, posicionamento e oportunidades de diferenciação.
  • Atuar no planejamento e execução de estratégias comerciais de médio e longo prazo, contribuindo diretamente para o fortalecimento do seu posicionamento frente ao mercado.
  • Acompanhar o pós-venda, garantindo a boa performance das operações comercializadas e relacionamento contínuo com os lojistas.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da área e do portfólio, propondo ações para otimização de resultados.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Experiência sólida no mercado de shopping centers, varejo ou marcas de perfil premium, com vivência em negociações complexas e vendas consultivas.
  • Domínio de técnicas de negociação e forte capacidade de influência em ambientes com múltiplos stakeholders.

title: Area Sales Manager (Pernambuco, Bahia State)
description:
Ecorobotix SA. creates innovative robotic solutions that reduce the negative ecological impact of modern agriculture. We have developed an AI-based ultra-high precision spot spraying technology that drastically reduces the amount of chemicals used in crop fields while keeping costs competitive. The technology is currently deployed on our tractor towed ARA machine. By joining our talented and dynamic team, you will contribute to a more sustainable, environment-friendly agriculture in an innovative scale-up at the cutting edge of technology. We are a revolutionary organization with a great work environment that supports creativity through self-motivation.


To pursue our growth in Brazil, we are hiring an experienced entrepreneurial mind based in Pernambuco, Bahia State for an:


Area Sales Manager


General objective of the role

As an Area Sales Manager of the Ecorobotix SA. Team, you will be responsible for managing and expanding the sales of agricultural machinery within a designated region. The role involves overseeing existing dealer relationships, optimizing dealer performance, and driving new business opportunities by identifying future dealers and customers as well as driving revenue growth. The Area Sales Manager will work closely with dealers to ensure product availability, support, and training, ensuring the company’s agricultural machinery is effectively marketed and sold. This position requires a leader with a deep understanding of market dynamics, strong leadership skills, and the ability to foster a results-oriented sales culture within the region.


Reporting lines and interactions

This role reports directly to the Commercial Director. Internally, you will closely collaborate with other members of the Sales team and other teams of Ecorobotix. Externally, you will interact with dealers, farmers, partners, associations, trade shows, Agronomists, and CCA’s.


A day in the life of an Area Sales Manager

The Area Sales Manager will travel across the designated territory to visit key accounts, meet new prospects, and support dealer partners. Whether you're pulling into a grower's yard or a dealership lot, you're the face of a cutting-edge ag-tech company that's reshaping the future of precision spraying.


You will showcase how our high-precision sprayer delivers real ROI: less chemical waste, more targeted application, and better yields. You walk growers through the technology— highlighting features like variable rate spraying and intelligent targeting—while grounding every conversation in real-world impact. You sit down and dig into the potential customer’s specific challenges and help them see how the product fits into their operation. You're not just selling equipment;
you're helping solve problems.


“You’re part field representative, part storyteller, part strategist. You’re a trusted advisor selling value, not just hardware.”


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect new customers across Brazil, managing all communication and driving the sales process through to contract signature.
  • Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, ensuring strong order generation and relationship development.
  • Assess customer solvency, share pricing information, negotiate terms, and suggest improvements to optimize pricing strategies.
  • Provide training and ongoing support to partners, while identifying opportunities for expanding and strengthening the partner network.
  • Actively participate in industry fairs, customer demos, and events to increase visibility and drive engagement in the region.
  • Foster collaboration and support within the distributor network to drive sales and enhance product reach.
  • Create compelling content in collaboration with the marketing team to support campaigns and enhance brand presence.


Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Sales and/or Agronomy, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in sales and hands-on experience in agriculture, ag-tech, or precision equipment.
  • Willingness to travel domestically in Brazil.

Must-Have

  • Experience in Ag-tech or chemical distribution.
  • Knowledge in Agronomy related to weeding in field crops.


Your Assets

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, willingness to build relationships with customers.
  • Exceptional written and verbal presentation skills, with clear & consistent communication.
  • High degree of independence, reliability, and spirit of initiative.
  • Driven individual with systematic, goal-oriented working methods.
  • Computer skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM tools.
  • Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills
  • Team-player

É ter apoio para suas necessidades mentais, físicas, financeiras e profissionais. Significa aprimorar suas habilidades e desenvolver sua carreira. E isso significa trabalhar em um ambiente que celebre a diversidade e seja justo e inclusivo.


OBJETIVO PRINCIPAL: Realizar todas as etapas de um processo de regulação de sinistros. Seus principais objetivos incluem garantir uma resposta eficiente e eficaz aos sinistros relatados pelos segurados, assegurando uma resolução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes envolvidas. Atuar na análise detalhada das circunstâncias do sinistro, na avaliação dos danos e na determinação das coberturas aplicáveis à apólice de seguro. Conduzir as comunicações com os segurados, corretores, agentes e outros envolvidos no processo, esclarecendo dúvidas, fornecendo orientações e negociando acordos quando necessário. O Analista de Sinistros também trabalha em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, financeiro e atendimento ao cliente, para resolver pendências e garantir a conformidade com as políticas e regulamentações do setor de seguros. Suas atividades envolvem desde a coleta inicial de informações sobre o sinistro até a conclusão do processo, incluindo a liquidação de valores de indenização e o encerramento do caso de forma satisfatória para todas as partes. Este profissional tem um maior foco técnico, com uma relação mais profunda com as etapas de Regulação de Sinistros.


FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS:

  • Atuação em sinistros de maior complexidade, especialmente property (residencial, incêndio, desmoronamento, entre outros);
  • Coleta estruturada de informações para viabilizar a continuidade do processo de regulação;
  • Atuação com diferentes linhas de negócio, podendo futuramente atender múltiplas áreas internas da Sedgwick.
  • Receber e registrar notificações de sinistros relatados por segurados, corretores ou agentes, e realizar uma análise inicial das circunstâncias do sinistro (pré-análise)
  • Conduzir investigações detalhadas sobre a validade e a extensão do sinistro, incluindo a avaliação de danos, coleta de evidências e entrevistas com testemunhas, quando necessário.
  • Realizar vistoria remota assistida através das tecnologias da Sedgwick coletando imagens para compor o laudo/processo do Sinistro, de acordo com as especificidades de cada ramo, condições gerais do produto e determinações dos Clientes.
  • Direcionamento do processo de vistoria, solicitando aproximações, registros fotográficos e esclarecimentos técnicos conforme o tipo de sinistro;
  • Determinar a aplicabilidade das coberturas da apólice ao sinistro reportado, verificando os termos, condições e limitações da apólice de seguro.
  • Estabelecer comunicação com os segurados para fornecer orientações sobre o processo de regulação de sinistros, esclarecer dúvidas e solicitar documentação adicional, quando necessário.
  • Negociar acordos e resoluções com os segurados, corretores, agentes ou terceiros envolvidos no sinistro, com o objetivo de alcançar uma solução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes, quando aplicável ao escopo contratado pelos Clientes da Sedgwick.
  • Solicitar e coletar documentos relevantes relacionados ao sinistro, como registros médicos, estimativas de reparo, relatórios policiais e outros documentos necessários para a análise e avaliação do sinistro, de acordo com a documentação exigida por cada Cliente para as coberturas dos produtos comercializados.
  • Determinar a responsabilidade das partes envolvidas no sinistro e avaliar os impactos na resolução do sinistro, considerando as leis, regulamentos, condições gerais do produto, coberturas e demais aspectos do sinistro que está sendo analisado, resultando em um pagamento total, parcial ou a uma negativa de indenização.
  • Avaliar os danos causados pelo sinistro e determinar os valores de indenização de acordo com as coberturas da apólice e os procedimentos estabelecidos pela Seguradora.
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre a investigação, análise e resolução do sinistro, documentando todas as etapas do processo e as decisões tomadas, de acordo com o Book de Regras de cada Cliente da Sedgwick.
  • Monitorar e gerenciar pendências relacionadas aos sinistros em aberto, garantindo que sejam resolvidas de forma oportuna e eficiente, buscando apoio das áreas internas da Sedgwick, Seguradora ou Corretora e/ou buscando solucionar pendências junto ao cliente, como por exemplo a obtenção de documentação complementar.
  • Registrar todas as atividades, decisões e informações relevantes sobre os sinistros nos sistemas de gerenciamento de sinistros da Sedgwick e/ou dos Clientes, garantindo a precisão e a integridade dos dados.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, atendimento ao cliente, financeiro e etc, para resolver questões e pendências relacionadas aos sinistros, buscando sua solução com a maior qualidade possível no menor tempo possível.
  • Acompanhar o progresso e o status dos processos de regulação de sinistros, fornecendo atualizações regulares aos segurados e outras partes interessadas conforme determinado no Book de Regras de cada Cliente, de acordo com as respectivas réguas de comunicação pré-estabelecidas assim como os canais disponíveis.
  • Garantir que todas as atividades e decisões relacionadas à regulação de sinistros estejam em conformidade com as leis, regulamentação SUSEP, condições gerais do produto e suas respectivas coberturas e especificidades determinadas pelos Clientes da Sedgwick formalizadas em um Book de Regras.


FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ADICIONAIS:

  • Executar análise e solucionar pendências.
  • Avaliar circunstâncias do sinistro e coberturas reclamadas vs coberturas contratadas
  • Obter informações e evidências relevantes (como vistorias e/ou documentos complementares)
  • Atender KPI's e SLA's e identificar oportunidade de melhorias.
  • Realizar acompanhamentos, buscar soluções e acionar áreas Internas da Sedgwick ou do Cliente dependendo da situação apresentada no contato, objetivando compartilhar o caso e buscar apoio com a solução de pendências.


REQUISITOS

Educação e licenças

  • Superior Completo ou Cursando: Administração, Negócios ou Correlatas, Ciências Atuariais, Economia ou Finanças ou Correlatas, Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Ciências da Computação ou Correlatas, Gestão de Seguros ou Gestão de Riscos ou Direito ou Engenharia.
  • Diferencial caso possua Certificações SUSEP.


Experiência

  • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em posição similar, atuando com o produto Vida (prestamista, coberturas de desemprego, morte e invalidez).
  • Experiência anterior em BPO's, seguradoras ou corretoras
  • Compreensão detalhada das políticas de seguros, incluindo termos, condições, coberturas e exclusões das apólices, para determinar a aplicabilidade ao sinistro.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de investigação para coletar evidências, realizar entrevistas e verificar informações relacionadas ao sinistro.
  • Capacidade de interpretar e analisar documentos legais relevantes para o sinistro, como apólices de seguro, relatórios policiais, registros médicos, contratos de locação entre outros.
  • Gerenciamento de documentos, incluindo verificação de integridade, organização e indexação adequada dos documentos
  • Conhecimento das leis e regulamentos que regem a indústria de seguros, incluindo legislação de seguros, responsabilidade civil, proteção ao consumidor e privacidade de dados.
  • Nível Intermediário – Pacote Office, com ênfase em Excel
  • Nível de Inglês Intermediário será considerado diferencial

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde;

§ Strong Python domain and integration via APIs.

§ Experience with intelligent automations and integration with corporate systems.

Soft Skills

§ Experimental and innovation-oriented mindset.

§ Experience with corporate copilots, advanced chatbots, and virtual assistants.

title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
  • Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
  • Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
  • Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
  • Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
  • Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
  • Professional proficiency in English.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
  • Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
  • Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
  • Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.


Our compensation package:

- Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).

- Profit Sharing.

- Transportation vouchers.

- Meals vouchers.

- Health and Dental insurance.

- Birthday day off.

title: Especialista De Arquitetura De Dados & Ia
description:
Descrição da vaga

O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.


Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um time com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças.


Nossa equipe de Arquitetura de Solução em IA é responsável por definir e acompanhar as frentes de Inteligência Artificial para padronizar uso de IA no Itaú. Cada solução é pensada para tornar as interações simples, rápidas e seguras, garantindo que as aplicações ofereçam fluidez e consistência. Trabalhamos para que a arquitetura, os Agentes e os serviços de IA habilitem jornadas generativas intuitivas, escaláveis e resilientes, conectando tecnologia e as necessidades para entregar valor real aos itubers e clientes.


Estamos buscando profissionais que dominem e possuam forte acuidade arquitetural, que tenha uma forte atuação hands-on em IA, domínio de DDD e design de plataformas que habilitem reuso e evolução contínua, com visão estratégica e capacidade de inovação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para a posição de Especialista de Arquitetura de Dados & IA , que queira se desenvolver e aprender, compartilhar, colaborar e inovar, entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.


Nessa função você vai:


Arquitetura e Plataforma

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de IA para o Banco PJ (alta escala, reuso, baixo acoplamento, personalizável), com observabilidade e tolerância a falhas de ponta a ponta.
  • Liderar decisões sobre tecnologias de IA Generativa guiado por trade-offs claros entre latência, consistência, capacidade de experimentação, custo e time-to-market.
  • Desenhar e governar soluções de IA e Agentes Generativos (aggregation, routing, orchestration, caching, personalization, feature flags, A/B) que sirvam múltiplos agentes trazendo jornadas generativas estáveis, versionamento, backward compatibility e observabilidade por domínio.
  • Direcionar o reuso dos capabilities/domain services (crm, auth, AI Models, CC, limites, PaaS), com bounded contexts bem definidos, APIs consistentes, catálogo de eventos e SDKs reutilizáveis.


Excelência de Arquitetura de Soluções

  • Tomar decisões de arquitetura usando DDD (ubiquitous language, aggregates, domain events, anticorruption layer) e arquitetura hexagonal (ports & adapters).
  • Implantar boas práticas: idempotência, backpressure, circuit breakers, retry with jitter, dead-letter queues, saga/outbox, blue/green & canary, zero-downtime migrations, security by design.
  • Garantir observabilidade abrangente (logs estruturados, tracing distribuído), SLOs por serviço e acompanhamento dos postmortems para aplicar ações de melhoria.
  • Otimizar custos na AWS (right-sizing, autoscaling, spot/ savings plans, cache e storage tiers, redução de chatter entre serviços).


Liderança Técnica

  • Definir north star architecture e roadmap evolutivo;
    alinhar múltiplos timesàs estratégias de Jornadas e Plataformas.
  • Mentorar arquitetas(os), engenheiras(os) sêniores, elevar o cdigo-foco e a qualidade técnica org-wide;
    conduzir design reviewse tech forums.
  • Colaborar com Produto e Design para equilibrar viabilidade técnica e valor de negocio, documentando trade-offs e riscos.
  • Atuar e liderar pelo exemplo, de forma hands-on no desenvolvimento de agentes, participando de revisões de codigo, testes e documentação.
  • Participar de rotações de suporte, acompanhamento, deploys fora do horário respondendo a incidentes quando necessário.


Requisitos e qualificações

title: Auditor Sênior
description:
Main responsibilities of the position:


Job Summary:


The Senior Auditor within Global Internal Audit (GIA) executes independent, objective assurance and advisory activities to assess the effectiveness of the Bank’s governance, risk management, and internal control processes. This hands‑on role supports audit engagements across all phases, including planning, risk assessment, fieldwork, reporting, and issue validation, and may lead assigned audit components or workstreams. The Senior Auditor is responsible for delivering assigned audit activities and documentation, identifying risks and control gaps, developing clear and actionable recommendations, and supporting the Audit In‑Charge (AIC) and Audit Manager with engagement execution, coordination, and stakeholder communication.


Major Responsibilities:


  • Execute risk‑based internal audit engagements in accordance with the IIA’s International Professional Practices Framework (IPPF), GIA Methodology, and applicable banking regulatory expectations.
  • Assess the design and operating effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal control processes across banking products, operations, and support functions.
  • Apply professional skepticism and personal accountability to identify control weaknesses, assess root causes, and evaluate the impact on risk and risk management practices.
  • Generate insightful, well‑articulated audit observations that clearly convey significance, risk impact, and management implications, and report audit findings and issues to Audit Management.
  • Prepare and maintain high‑quality, stand‑alone audit documentation and workpapers that fully support audit conclusions and enable independent re‑performance.
  • Support the Audit In‑Charge (AIC) and Audit Manager with engagement execution, issue validation, and effective communication with management and key stakeholders.
  • Operate with an innovative and flexible mindset by continuously identifying opportunities to enhance audit consistency, efficiency, quality, and overall value.
  • Maintain effective working relationships with business, risk, and compliance partners while preserving independence and objectivity.


Desired experience for the role:


  • 4+ years of progressive experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, or compliance, preferably within banking or financial services.
  • Experience executing risk‑based internal audit engagements end‑to‑end, including planning, fieldwork, reporting, and issue validation.
  • Hands‑on experience evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls across banking products, operations, and support functions.
  • Experience applying IIA IPPF standards and working within environments subject to banking regulatory oversight.
  • Experience producing stand‑alone audit documentation and workpapers that support conclusions and enable independent re‑performance.
  • Experience developing and reporting clear, risk‑focused audit observations that articulate significance, root cause, and impact on risk and risk management practices.


Specific knowledge, skills, and certifications required for the role:


  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, required due to audit methodology, documentation, and regular interaction with global and local stakeholders conducted in English.
  • CIA preferred;
    CISA, CRMA, CRC, CPA-10, CPA-20 or equivalent professional certification is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of internal audit principles, risk‑based auditing, and internal control frameworks within a banking environment.
  • Ability to apply professional skepticism, sound judgment, and personal accountability when evaluating risks and controls.
  • Capability to develop clear, risk‑focused audit observations and communicate issues effectively to Audit Management and stakeholders.
  • Ability to prepare high‑quality, stand‑alone audit documentation that supports conclusions and enables independent re‑performance.
  • 'Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • Advanced degree (e.G., MBA or Master’s in Accounting/Finance) is a plus.

  • Avaliar e acompanhar planos de mitigação de riscos de Compliance, garantindo o devido reporte à coordenação;
  • Apoiar na elaboração e revisão de normativos e políticas internas da área;
  • Analisar cláusulas contratuais relacionadas a LGPD, anticorrupção e aspectos sociais, orientando sobre a adequação conforme o objeto da contratação;
  • Conduzir treinamentos presenciais (in loco) para tratamento de situações específicas, conforme direcionamento do Comitê de Ética;
  • Atuar no apoio ao mapeamento e monitoramento do tratamento de dados pessoais, além de orientar as áreas internas sobre diretrizes da LGPD;
  • Manter interface direta com lideranças para alinhamento dos temas de Compliance, elaborar indicadores mensais da área e preparar materiais de comunicação e treinamento para diferentes públicos da companhia.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Superior completo em Administração, Direito, Psicologia e correlatos;
  • Conhecimento emCompliance, com entendimento das práticas e diretrizes da área;
  • Conhecimento intermediário no Pacote Office, com ênfase em Excel;

  • Conhecimento do Software Visio;

  • Gympass – para você cuidar da sua saúde física e ter muita energia!

A Copa Energia valoriza a vida por meio da segurança e do respeito com as pessoas e com o meio ambiente. Tratamos as pessoas como gostaríamos de ser tratados. É assim que construímos um ambiente íntegro, diverso e inclusivo.

Venha energizar vidas com a gente!

description:

Auxilia nas atividades de análise de crédito, faturamento, contas a receber e cobrança, atuando sob supervisão para garantir o processamento preciso e pontual das transações de crédito e contas a receber. Contribui para a eficiência e eficácia das operações do departamento.

title: Coordenador Pedagogico
description:
Coordenador(a) Acadêmico(a) | Idiomas para Adultos | Foco Corporativo


A LQuest esta contratando um profissional para liderar a área acadêmica e garantir consistência, qualidade pedagógica e evolução real na experiência de aprendizagem dos nossos alunos.


Esta função é estratégica para a operação. Procuramos alguém com repertório em ensino de idiomas para adultos, vivência em contexto corporativo e capacidade de desenvolver professores, acompanhar resultados e transformar desafios acadêmicos em soluções práticas, com impacto direto na experiência do aluno e na relação com nossos clientes.


Na LQuest, a área acadêmica vai além da gestão de aulas. Ela conecta metodologia, desenvolvimento docente, acompanhamento de jornada, relacionamento com RHs e melhoria contínua dos processos que sustentam a aprendizagem em um ambiente corporativo dinâmico.


Como esta função se encaixa na LQuest

Essa posição tem papel central na sustentação da nossa proposta de valor. A pessoa Coordenadora Pedagógica atua como ponte entre professores, alunos, clientes e operação, garantindo que nossos programas de inglês, espanhol e português para estrangeiros entreguem qualidade, consistência e aplicação prática no contexto profissional.


Como será o sucesso nesta função

Nos primeiros meses, esperamos que esse profissional consiga:

  • fortalecer a consistência pedagógica entre professores e programas;
  • acompanhar a evolução dos alunos com clareza e critério;
  • conduzir feedbacks, treinamentos e observações com qualidade;
  • atuar com segurança em situações sensíveis envolvendo alunos, docentes e clientes;
  • contribuir parao aprimoramento contínuo da experiência de aprendizagem e dos processos da área.


Responsabilidades


  • Liderar e desenvolver o time de professores, promovendo alinhamento, consistência e evolução contínua.
  • Garantir a qualidade pedagógica das aulas e da experiência de aprendizagem nos programas de inglês, espanhol e português para estrangeiros.
  • Acompanhar a evolução dos alunos com base no CEFR, do A1 ao C1.
  • Atuar no relacionamento com alunos e clientes corporativos, especialmente áreas de RH.
  • Conduzir treinamentos, observações de aula e feedbacks para o time docente.
  • Apoiar a criação, revisão e melhoria de planos de aula, trilhas e materiais complementares.
  • Atuar em temas estratégicos como engajamento, retenção, troca de professor, adequações de percurso e alinhamentos sensíveis com clientes.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos acadêmicos e para a evolução da experiência de aprendizagem na LQuest.
  • Utilizar tecnologia de forma inteligente e acompanhar oportunidades de inovação e uso prático de IA aplicada ao ensino.


Qualificações


Inglês avançado, com nível mínimo C1.

Experiência com ensino de idiomas para adultos em contexto corporativo.

Vivência em coordenação pedagógica, supervisão acadêmica ou liderança de professores.

Boa comunicação, escuta ativa e habilidade de gestão de pessoas.

Organização, proatividade e olhar crítico para qualidade.

Capacidade de transitar bem entre professores, alunos e clientes corporativos.

Familiaridade com aprendizagem de adultos e princípios de andragogia será considerada um diferencial relevante.


Diferenciais


Conhecimento em espanhol.

Vivência no modelo B2B.

Experiência com desenvolvimento de materiais.

Interesse por inovação, tecnologia e IA aplicada ao ensino.

Familiaridade com redes sociais e gamificação aplicadas à aprendizagem.

Presencial, de segunda a sexta-feira, em São Paulo

Não se trata de vaga tradicional de empresa estruturada, mas de uma parceria técnica para construir, testar e evoluir um projeto com propósito.
Qualificações desejadas:
– Experiência em desenvolvimento de software (frontend, backend ou full stack).
– Interesse em projetos em fase inicial e construção colaborativa.
– Capacidade de dialogar, propor soluções e evoluir o projeto junto.
Formação acadêmica e metodologias específicas são bem-vindas, mas não obrigatórias.

title: Desenvolvedor Sap Abap
description:
We Are Hiring: SAP ABAP Consultant

We are looking for an experienced SAP ABAP Consultant to join our team, acting as a technical expert and contributing to high-impact solutions across complex SAP environments. If you have strong hands-on experience, enjoy solving technical challenges, and thrive in collaborative environments, this role is for you.


✅ Responsibilities

  • Act as the technical expert, ensuring quick turnaround in identifying application issues and delivering timely solutions.
  • Transform business requirements into detailed technical specifications to code, test, and debug programs.
  • Analyze functional design documents and translate requirements into technical design deliverables.
  • Develop, code, document, and execute unit tests, system tests, integration tests, and acceptance tests for high‑complexity functionalities.
  • Perform performance tuning across multiple functions to ensure optimal system performance.
  • Collaborate with other technical team members during solution design, delivery, and deployment.
  • Oversee integration system activities (PI/PO), including technical architecture monitoring (scalability, availability, archiving).
  • Execute performance tuning activities for SAP integration components.
  • Provide consulting and technical expertise on new and existing initiatives.
  • Apply strong object-oriented programming principles.
  • Ability to multitask and manage several deliverables/projects simultaneously.
  • Advanced English for conversations and technical discussions.


What You Can Expect From Us

  • Continuous professional development and constant evolution of your skills, aligned with your personal interests.
  • Opportunities to work on international projects outside Brazil.
  • A collaborative, diverse, and innovative environment that encourages teamwork and knowledge sharing.

title: Analista De Operações De Fundos
description:
Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Executar as rotinas operacionais dos fundos sob gestão, em conformidade com a Resolução CVM 175
  • Acompanhar as carteiras diárias, operações no mercado secundário e batimento de cotas.
  • Acompanhar e validar processos de cotização, liquidação financeira e movimentações de investidores
  • Interagir diariamente com administradores fiduciários, custodiante, controladoria, distribuidores e auditoria
  • Monitorar prazos regulatórios, obrigações operacionais e compliance operacional
  • Conferir posições de ativos, eventos financeiros e conciliações
  • Controlar fluxos de caixa e movimentações financeiras dos fundos
  • Elaborar relatórios operacionais e dar suporte às áreas de gestão, risco e compliance
  • Acompanhar indicadores operacionais e propor melhorias de processos


✅ Requisitos:


  • Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência prévia em operações de fundos regulados pela CVM (preferencialmente CVM 175)
  • Conhecimento das rotinas de administradores fiduciários e custodiante
  • Familiaridade com legislação e normas aplicáveis a fundos de investimento

title: Manufacturing Support Engineers - MES Syncade
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Manufacturing Support Engineers - MES Syncade who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

  • Proficiency in Manufacturing Engineering MES, with a strong background in Syncade MES.
  • Deep understanding of the Life Sciences domain, specifically in regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle and validated system environments.
  • Experience working within Agile frameworks and sprint-based development processes.
  • Solid knowledge of database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle).

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in Manufacturing Engineering MES, specifically in life sciences or pharmaceutical industries, is required.
  • Candidates must have completed 15 years of full-time education.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform independently and progressively grow into a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for MES applications.
  • Serve as the first point of contact for shop-floor users; diagnose, resolve, and document issues for Syncade.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Quality, and IT to restore service quickly and minimize production impact
  • Propose and deliver practical solutions to business and technical problems.
  • Maintain and improve support knowledge (KB articles, SOPs) and provide targeted user coaching and quick tips to reduce repeat issues.
  • Monitor system health and alerts; identify patterns and propose corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) or continuous improvement suggestions. Conduct and participate in peer code reviews; provide constructive feedback to uphold development standards.
  • Remain current on application development trends, MES technologies, and industry best practices.

title: Ivanti ITSM Support
description:
We are looking for an Ivanti ITSM Specialist to take over the managed support and administration of an existing Ivanti environment. The main goal is to ensure platform stability, manage day-to-day operations, and support the ITSM application while parallel assessments are running.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Administration: Handle day-to-day configuration and maintenance of the Ivanti ITSM platform.
  • Queue Management: Manage incident and request queues, performing triage and ensuring timely resolution.
  • User Management: Administer users, groups, and maintain the service catalog.
  • Reporting: Generate and maintain dashboards and operational reports as needed.
  • Maintenance & Support: Provide minor enhancements and break-fix support to ensure \"nothing stops, nothing breaks.\"
  • Vendor Liaison: Act as the point of contact with Ivanti vendors for technical escalations.


Technical Requirements (Must-haves)

  • Experience: Proven experience administering Ivanti Service Management (ISM) or Ivanti Neurons for ITSM .
  • ITSM Knowledge: Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes (Incident, Request, Change management).
  • Reporting: Ability to run and customize reports within the Ivanti environment.
  • Soft Skills: Proactive \"keep the lights on\" mindset, ability to work independently, and clear communication.

title: Senior NodeJS Developer
description:
Senior Node.js Developer

Location: Brazil (preferred)

Contract / Contract-to-Hire | Immediate Start

We’re looking for a Senior Node.js Developer to join a fast-growing engineering team working on regulated financial platforms across LATAM.


This is an urgent, high-impact hire. You’ll be joining at a critical stage, helping to deliver key product milestones and scale secure, high-availability systems in a regulated environment.

If you enjoy ownership, autonomy, and building systems that genuinely matter - this role is for you.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and scaling backend services using Node.js
  • Deploying and managing applications in Kubernetes
  • Working with MongoDB in production environments
  • Contributing to cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS)
  • Identifying technical risks and proactively solving them
  • Collaborating closely with product and engineering stakeholders


What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js (essential)
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments
  • Solid knowledge of MongoDB
  • Experience with Azure or AWS (nice to have)
  • Comfortable working in regulated or high-availability environments


More importantly, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership
  • Communicates clearly
  • Thinks ahead and manages risk
  • Works independently
  • Thrives in fast-paced teams


Experience in Financial Services, Open Finance, or Banking is a plus.

title: Engenheiro DevOps (inglês fluente)
description:
Principais Responsabilidades:


• Instalar, configurar, administrar e dar suporte a sistemas e serviços de Core Banking em diferentes ambientes (DEV/UAT/PROD).

• Automatizar atividades operacionais e de deploy utilizando Rundeck e Ansible (orquestração de jobs, playbooks/roles, inventários e gerenciamento seguro de credenciais).

• Criar e manter runbooks, procedimentos operacionais e documentação padrão para permitir execuções repetíveis e auditáveis.

• Fornecer suporte à produção e participar da resposta a incidentes, incluindo triagem, correção e análises pós-incidente (RCA/gestão de problemas).

• Monitorar a saúde e o desempenho dos sistemas; implementar melhorias proativas em disponibilidade, resiliência e capacidade.

• Gerenciar configuração, aplicação de patches e ciclo de vida de componentes de sistema operacional, middleware e aplicações, garantindo conformidade com controles internos.

• Coordenar o controle, renovação e implantação de certificados digitais (ex.: TLS/SSL), incluindo inventário, monitoramento de vencimento, planejamento de mudanças, validação e documentação para evitar interrupções de serviço.

• Trabalhar com equipes de aplicações, infraestrutura e fornecedores para solucionar problemas complexos de ponta a ponta e garantir resolução no prazo.

• Apoiar o gerenciamento de mudanças, planejando, testando, documentando e executando alterações com avaliação de riscos e aprovações adequadas.

• Contribuir para a melhoria de práticas de CI/CD e releases (controle de versão, gestão de artefatos, consistência de ambientes), quando aplicável.

• Aplicar boas práticas de segurança, incluindo hardening, controle de acesso, gestão de segredos e auditabilidade.


Requisitos:

• Mais de 5 anos em Instituições Financeiras; conhecimento do mercado financeiro brasileiro e de produtos/processos de core banking.

• Experiência prática em DevOps/automação com Rundeck e Ansible.

• Conhecimento em scripts (ex.: PowerShell, Bash, Python) para automação e ferramentas operacionais.

• Sólido conhecimento em Windows e Unix/Linux, incluindo troubleshooting, performance e aplicação de patches.

• Experiência com suporte a aplicações e middleware (ex.: servidores web/app, agendamento batch, transferência de arquivos).

• Experiência com ferramentas/tecnologias corporativas como SQL Server, Oracle, Control-M, MQ, ServiceNow, Splunk, Jira, Nexus, LDAP/AD.

• Conhecimento prático em gestão de certificados (inventário, planejamento de renovação/rotação, implantação e validação pós-mudança).

• Entendimento de conceitos de CI/CD e workflows baseados em Git / pipelines de deploy.

• Forte habilidade de comunicação com stakeholders; capacidade de trabalhar com fornecedores globais/locais e equipes internas.

• Inglês avançado.


Desejável:

• Experiência com SAFe; exposição ao GCP.

• Experiência com iniciativas de migração/modernização.

• Espanhol.

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital


Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Senior Magento Developer (Magento 2 / Performance Focus)
description:
Senior Magento Developer (Magento 2 / Performance Focus) | Remote


QAT Global, a QAT Global US-based IT consulting firm with more than 30 years in the market, is hiring a Senior Magento Developer in Brazil to join an international project supporting a US client.

This professional will work directly with client stakeholders in the US and collaborate with distributed teams across Brazil, Costa Rica, and the United States, contributing to performance improvements, technical analysis, and long-term platform stability in a complex Magento environment.


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Hiring Model: CLT only


Main Challenges:


  • Analyze and improve performance across the Magento platform, identifying backend, database, and front-end bottlenecks
  • Review legacy customizations and refactor technical debt impacting platform efficiency
  • Optimize JavaScript execution and storefront rendering performance
  • Evaluate modules, extensions, and integrations according to Magento best practices
  • Support code deployment and version control using GitHub and CI/CD workflows
  • Investigate root causes of production issues and propose scalable technical solutions
  • Contribute with architectural recommendations focused on scalability, maintainability, and security


Required Experience:


  • Strong professional experience with Magento development (Magento 2 strongly preferred)
  • Strong expertise in Magento architecture, module development, and customizations
  • Proven experience troubleshooting performance issues and legacy code problems
  • Solid knowledge of JavaScript performance optimization in Magento storefronts
  • Strong experience with PHP, HTML5, CSS, and codebase improvement
  • Experience with repository management and deployment workflows using GitHub
  • Ability to work directly with technical teams and client stakeholders in English


Preferred Background:


  • Magento caching and database optimization
  • CI/CD and DevOps practices
  • Code audits and technical health assessments
  • Large-scale e-commerce environments


This role is particularly relevant for professionals who have already worked with complex Magento environments, production troubleshooting, and technical modernization of existing platforms.
company: QAT Global | Custom Software Development & IT Staffing Solutions - US, Brazil & Costa Rica Nearshore

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

Salário Fixo + Remuneração Variável + Bônus Mensal
